bio: 我那台洁面刷最近一开机就抖得厉害。要换个轻一点的，洗完脸手不发麻就行。
晚饭后喜欢看电动洁面刷拆解，刷头材质比品牌故事有趣。
退完最后一笔，家用美容仪不会再买，也别发体验邀请。
脸部导入笔 两张图 旧笔记搬家中。
夜班和周末民谣。红光面罩借来用两晚，想看看戴着能不能靠沙发。
手上的微電流儀還可以，我喜歡追不同檔位的原理和使用筆記。
旧洁面仪换成手洗以后舒服多了。新机不考虑，试用券也还回去。
邻居说她想试个 LED 面罩，我替她发一下群链接。
最近戴眼鏡看不清面罩的燈號，有大字或聲響提醒的機種才適合我。
下班收集红光面罩科普，最近终于搞懂波段图。继续当闲读。
射頻美容儀我已拆箱退回，明確不想再試這一類。
紅光面罩的尺寸抄在照片下面。電池資料另附。
下班画速写。想给家人换一支可以单手暂停的脸部按摩仪。
旅行照片和家用射频评测都看，我主要爱看品牌怎么做计时。
Returned the LED face mask. I don't want a replacement or another demo, thanks.
美容仪说明书放在昨天那条帖子里，供课堂小组用。
居家护理，中午能留出十分钟。家用射频想找可锁低档的，手一滑就误调太烦。
我对洁面刷的样子很感兴趣，先攒些图做配色板。
No more powered face tools for me. I declined the microcurrent trial after asking them to cancel.
微电流是什么？从影片里记下来，问句不是我写的。
先把两款光疗面罩都戴过。现在在比哪款遮光更好，月底挑一个放家里。
钢琴和 nightly skincare。关注了几个美肤仪开箱号，看评测挺放松。
美容仪维修寄售。微电流刷头只供连锁门店，采购找前台。
要是以后市集刚好有光疗仪抽奖，也许能看一眼。
最近预算都在养猫，微电流美容仪给自己留了五百。能用水洗的我才下单。
I collect old face brush designs for a mood board. I enjoy the diagrams more than the product demos.
红光护理罩代理拿样，品牌方留批次号。整箱报价统一发。
Dorm room / face masks / recipe photos. That's the folder title.
Skincare after night shift. I need a face light mask that I can pause without taking my gloves off.
Happy with the skin light panel I have. I follow research threads about the newer designs.
本号发射频美容设备到店视频。想试的顾客先和我们店员约。
My cousin wants a home RF device. These are her screenshots from the group chat.
My facial cleansing wand stopped charging. Borrowing a silicone brush from a friend before I choose the replacement.
Coffee runs and facial tool teardown clips. Curious how a microcurrent pen measures what it's doing.
Microcurrent tools in stock for salons. Trade samples go out Friday; wholesale inquiries only.
Red-light visor dimensions, page four of the old course packet.
I make pottery on weekends. Comparing two home RF skincare tools that fit my tiny shelf.
I like experimenting with routines on my existing face roller. The maintenance videos are oddly calming.
LED skin masks on display at our kiosk. The trial appointment is for shoppers at the counter.
Maybe someday someone here will try a face wand if the fair loans them. No plans yet.
The metal head on my facial massager gets too warm. I need one that can stay cool through an evening routine.
Mostly bread recipes. I spend lunch breaks learning how RF skincare handles heat.
Powered face brush supplies and shop repairs. I handle purchase orders on the vendor side.
I found the LED skincare fitting receipt while moving. The envelope is marked 2022.
Birthday list: a red-light face mask for my sister. I've put the adjustable one on hold at the shop.
Cycling / 晚间护肤. I like reading which face masks have removable liners, just for the design.
剧团灯光。想找个发红光的 LED 面罩给纸偶戴，护肤功能用不到。
Interview notes · 光疗灯 · bicycle tools. I don't know which photo matches which note.
I booked ten minutes at a beauty counter to try their microcurrent pen on my own cheeks.
我在买射频测试头给收音机测信号，跟护肤设备是两回事。
Apartment garden and low-key skincare. Replacing my LED face visor this month after the clasp snapped.
这回买的红光灯板照水草；美肤面罩只是拿来比长宽。
WFH 后晚间护肤。想补个 portable 洁面刷放公司，能在洗手池直接冲最好。
Need an illuminated face visor for a robot head. It won't be worn by anyone.
二手唱片 / skincare。想自己挑一台微电流仪，手边这台一碰水就关机。
Shopping for a soft brush to clean fountain pens. The facial scrubber in my photos was a prop.
Coffee and 居家护肤. I need a facial toning wand that keeps its settings between uses.
职业学校新学期备货，脸部美容设备根据老师领用单给采购部。
Skincare + 周末攀岩. Trying on two LED masks tomorrow to see which works with glasses.
Clinic inventory desk. Ordering radiofrequency facial devices under our annual equipment contract.
